rankings.good: JT has 84.2 points and Bryce Young (76.9) plus Shough (74.4) have been real QBs. Jake Bates hit for 18.
rankings.bad: 0-4. Would have beaten Tony with the right lineup, Ollie Gordon scored 18.0 on the bench while Braelon Allen got 8.7. Saquon has 23.0 points in four games, AJ Brown is still on IR and Jacobs is still on the exempt list.

rankings.good: CeeDee is 2nd among all WRs with 112.2 points after a 41.3 this week, and Bowers has 48.2 in two games since coming back.
rankings.bad: Left 61.5 on the bench, the most in the league. Hockenson (24.9) and Emanuel Wilson (27.0) sat while Mariota put up 5.5. Wins that one with the right lineup. Daniels is still out with the elbow.

rankings.good: First win. Puka is back and went for 27.7, Tee Higgins has gotten better every week (8.9, 14.5, 21.0, 26.7) and Brian Robinson Jr. came off waivers with 25.7.
rankings.bad: The injuries are real. Achane is done for the year with the ACL, Etienne is on IR and Caleb is out with the hamstring. McBride has dropped every week (24.5, 18.1, 16.5, 10.1).

rankings.good: Back to .500. Maye finally showed up (30.4) and Kyren (87.7) plus Hubbard (79.0) have carried this team.
rankings.bad: Benched Kyren for his best game of the year (36.7) and only won by 9.8. Chase has two quiet weeks out of four (3.2 and 5.7).

rankings.good: Bijan has 494 rushing yards, 2nd in the NFL, and 105.4 fantasy points. Nabers finally broke out with 23.2.
rankings.bad: Left 53.6 points on the bench, 2nd most in the league. Started Rice (0.0) and Kelce (3.5) with Doubs (23.8) and LaPorta (22.4) sitting. Baker is still out with the thumb.

rankings.good: 3rd in the league in points at 1-3. Nobody has had worse luck. ARSB (91.3) and Olave (90.1) have been steady all year and Cousins put up 28.0 in his first start.
rankings.bad: Stafford went for 8.0 and the bench only had 4.4 to give. DeVonta and Coker both scored 0. The points are there, the wins aren't.

rankings.good: Allen (124.9) and Love (81.2) is still one of the best QB rooms in the league, and Javonte (81.8) has quietly been an RB1.
rankings.bad: Lost to the 0-3 team. Started McConkey (0.0) and Kincaid (1.7) and left Javonte's 31.3 and Carnell Tate's 19.5 on the bench. Wins that one with the right lineup.

rankings.good: 3-1 and 4th in scoring. Dak (102.6) and Burrow (92.8) have been steady every single week, and Zay is back to being the WR1 with 25.8.
rankings.bad: Monangai scored 28.0 on the bench while RJ Harvey started. Gibbs had his quietest game of the year (17.7) and Parker Washington put up 2.0 as a starter.

rankings.good: Dropped 202.9, the highest score of the season. T-Mac went for 45.2, the best game by any WR this year, and Purdy (128.2) plus Lamar (95.4) is the top scoring QB pair in the league.
rankings.bad: Justin Jefferson has 13.7 points since week 1. He also picked up Kyler Murray, the QB Dean cut, which is either a stash or a cry for help.

rankings.good: 4-0 and still the top scoring team in the league (651.9). Goff (114.5) and Mahomes (107.1) are the 3rd and 4th highest scoring QBs in the league, and Nico came back from the hamstring with 30.8.
rankings.bad: Left 27.4 on the bench, including 30.2 from Stroud. JSN had his first quiet game (12.6) and TE is a weekly coin flip between Likely and Kraft.
